title: Filed Minimum-Earned Rule for Renewal Business
content:
Under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), the tenure share of the minimum-earned charge on a coverage return follows the tenure of the Owner Auto Policy term the coverage belongs to. This is the company's filed minimum-earned rule for renewal business.

| Owner Auto Policy term | Tenure share of the minimum-earned charge |
|---|---|
| Renewal term with a term number of at least 3 | Zero |
| Any other renewal term (term number 2) | One half |
| New-business term (term number 1) | One (the whole charge) |

**Points of judgement (hypothetical).**
- The fifth term of a policy bears no minimum-earned charge on this account.
- The second term bears half of it.
- The first term bears the whole of it.
